summary: A single bounded synthetic-fixture held-success probe confirmed login authority stays bound to submitted email A and controller state clears the newer draft, but the delegated-equivalent login tree remains at newer email B after route reentry. The success postprocessing changes state after service notification, and the route-epoch guard skips navigation when the user has reentered login; the final dispatch path does not otherwise notify/render. This is a controller/state-to-view notification divergence, not an authority divergence. Scope is actual checkpoint HH source plus delegated-equivalent render tree; mounted-browser behavior is not claimed.

scope_and_method.execution: Exactly one invocation of the pre-frozen Node probe; no retry.
scope_and_method.environment: Synthetic random .test account, explicit fixture provider, in-memory storage, actual pinned HH controller/runtime/site modules.
scope_and_method.interaction: Register and locally approve synthetic fixture account A; hold Session.login(A); update login draft to distinct B; navigate to about and back to login; release successful login; inspect controller authority/state, runtime, Parts/storage, and delegated-equivalent render tree.

observations.pre_run_expected_observation: Successful authority remains A; route stays reentered login; overlay clears; rendered input follows authority projection A. Clearing B alone was not defined as a defect.
observations.pre_run_falsifier: Unexpected setup failure, login failure, attempt count other than one, request/session authority diverging from submitted A, or secret presence.

first_red_assertion.assertion: successful authority projection displays authenticated email, not newer draft
first_red_assertion.disposition: Meaningful predeclared target red: controller state is authenticated A with null draft while the last emitted render tree still displays B. The assertion failed before any later checks; there were no later checks.

observations.authority_conclusion: The service request and authenticated session stayed on A; no evidence of misdirected authority or account switching.
observations.root_source_readback: Root read the same probe, stderr, controller, and actual app callbacks: service() notifies before event-specific login success postprocessing; login then clears loginDraft and updates session email; routeEpoch mismatch suppresses redirect/navigation; setCommunityRole does not provide an app subscription/compensating render; actual app onChange calls render, and dispatch returns without post-render. This matches the observed stale tree.
observations.test_coverage_note: Existing same-email success/fallback/authority-clear tests do not exercise distinct newer B during held success plus route reentry.

limitations: This result is a synthetic fixture/controller projection observation. It is not mounted-browser QA and does not establish production behavior. The only raw run output is the preserved assertion failure; no product files, tests, build outputs, Git state, or native state were changed by H1.
